llm_fields.description: The scheme aims to upgrade the skills of artisans in leather technology, footwear/leather goods making, and designing by sending them for advanced training at renowned institutions like CFTI Chennai, CLRI, and Karnataka Institute of Leather Technology.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans belonging to specified sub‑castes among scheduled castes, have passed SSLC/PUC/Degree, be at least 18 years old, have an annual family income not exceeding ₹30,000 in rural areas and ₹25,000 in urban areas, and must not have received benefits from other schemes (except training) or have family members employed in government or semi‑government organisations.
